brief: Something to keep my sewing supplies tidy.

requirements.requirement: Keeps sewing supplies tidy: several separate storage bins for different supplies
requirements.evidence: 3 bins: bin:0,0,0 (half-depth, 3 compartments), bin:1,0,0 (full-depth, 2 compartments), bin:1,-1,1 (2 storeys deep, 2 compartments).

requirements.requirement: Small notions (buttons, pins, bobbins) sorted into divided compartments

requirements.requirement: A deep spot for tall items like scissors, rulers and marking pens

requirements.requirement: Neat finished caddy: no open faces left uncapped
requirements.evidence: capOpenFaces added 16 solid caps and lockJoints added 2 joint bolts. check_build found no issues.

finish.summary: A sewing caddy made of three hex cells in a triangle (22 parts). It has a half-depth bin with 3 compartments for small notions like buttons, pins and bobbins. It has a full-depth bin with 2 compartments for thread spools and a tape measure. The third cell is two storeys tall and holds a 2-compartment bin about 160 mm deep for scissors, rulers and marking pens. All open faces are capped and the joints are bolted. check_build found no rule issues and the mesh check came back clear. The prop catalog has no sewing items, so I staged it with what was closest: a tape measure in the full bin and a pencil standing in the deep bin. The pencil stands below the deep bin's rim, so you can't see it from the side. I also tried a standing paint brush there, but the configurator refused it because it wouldn't stay upright.

lines.label: Bin, full depth, 2 compartments, 2 stories deep
Edge cap · male, two stories tall
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
